channel.title: 0xelitesystem new repos
channel.description: New open-source tools and references from 0xelitesystem. All MIT, all self-contained.

item.title: signing-cert-expiry-planner
item.description: A single-file browser tool that turns a Windows code signing certificate's validity dates into the dates you actually have to act on: when each untimestamped artifact goes dark, when every future renewal falls, and the last safe day to ship a brid...

item.title: claude-shipping-plugins
item.description: A Claude Code plugin marketplace for the parts of shipping software that fail

item.title: mcp-state-token-designer
item.description: Design the binding set that goes inside an MCP `requestState` token, mint one with real WebCrypto HMAC-SHA-256 in the browser, then read the residual table: which attack each binding stops, and the one attack that none of them stop.

item.title: windows-code-signing-and-smartscreen-reference
item.description: A plain-language reference for shipping signed Windows software after the

item.title: silent-breaking-changes-reference
item.description: A catalogue of five 2026 platform changes that reached working code without ever

item.title: eval-peeking-planner
item.description: Measure what checking an eval mid-run does to your false-positive rate, then compute the paired sample size and the group-sequential boundaries that fix it. Monte Carlo plus recursive numerical integration, in one HTML file, with no libraries and ...

item.title: mojibake-inverter
item.description: Paste text that an encoding mistake mangled, recover the original exactly, see the full set of codecs that could have caused the damage, and get the positions that cannot be recovered at all.

item.title: mcp-header-annotation-validator
item.description: Paste an MCP tool definition and find out, clause by clause, whether a conforming Streamable HTTP client will silently delete it from `tools/list` because of an `x-mcp-header` annotation.

item.title: yaml-type-coercion-auditor
item.description: Paste YAML and see every scalar that resolves to a different type, or a different value, depending on which parser reads the file.

item.title: staged-rollout-cohort-simulator
item.description: Runs the electron-updater staged rollout formula against freshly generated install ids and shows that a staged rollout is a fixed cohort, not a rotating sample.

item.title: electron-release-matrix-auditor
item.description: Paste a GitHub Actions workflow. It reports which release artifacts the matrix legs will fight over, and whether two legs can create two draft releases for one tag.

item.title: ai-deletion-and-retention-reference
item.description: Where user data actually lives in an AI stack, what deleted honestly means in each store, and the two places a delete request cannot reach: trained weights and immutable backups.

item.title: span-offset-debugger
item.description: Paste text and a span, name the system that produced the offsets and the one that reads them, and see the same numbers select four different substrings.

item.title: mcp-server-privilege-inventory
item.description: Paste an MCP client config and get a privilege inventory: which servers launch a subprocess as your user, how mutable each code reference is, and which secrets you hand each one.

item.title: embedding-similarity-calibrator
item.description: Paste your own embedding vectors and get the empirical cosine distribution of unrelated pairs, drawn against the exact closed-form null for random unit vectors in the same dimension.

item.title: metastable-failure-explorer
item.description: Solve the retry-amplification fixed point for a service and its dependency, enumerate every equilibrium, and trace the hysteresis loop between the tipping point and the recovery point.

item.title: json-precision-auditor
item.description: Paste JSON and see which number literals change value when parsed into IEEE 754 doubles, including the ones that re-print byte-for-byte identical to what you pasted.

item.title: rag-ingest-injection-scanner
item.description: Drop an HTML page or a .docx you are about to index and see every character a text extractor hands the model that a reader never sees: hidden runs, clipped text, off-canvas payloads.

item.title: agent-sandbox-linter
item.description: Paste an AI agent's command allowlist and host allowlist and see which permitted programs are documented to run code from their own argv, and which host wildcards anyone can provision a name under.

item.title: llm-judge-calibrator
item.description: Paste an LLM judge's confusion matrix from a human-labeled calibration set and get a prediction-powered corrected pass rate with a confidence interval, beside Rogan-Gladen and its refusal states.

item.title: llm-output-sink-scanner
item.description: Paste a model response and see every URL your renderer would silently GET, every cell a spreadsheet would run as a formula, and every terminal escape that overwrites what you read.

item.title: llm-message-array-linter
item.description: Paste the Anthropic `messages` array from a request that returned a 400 and get the exact block index that broke it, plus every index where the transcript can legally be truncated.

item.title: model-pickle-scanner
item.description: Drop a .pt, .bin, .ckpt or .pkl and read its pickle opcodes in the browser without executing them, including exactly which global or opcode makes torch.load(weights_only=True) refuse the file.

item.title: eval-significance-calculator
item.description: Paste two eval runs, or just the counts, and find out whether that 3-point score move is a real improvement or sampling noise.

item.title: llm-timeout-budget
item.description: Model your worst-case LLM request end to end, check it against every timeout between your code and the API, and find out whether streaming saves you or does nothing at all.

item.title: prompt-cache-inspector
item.description: Paste two consecutive Anthropic request bodies and find the exact byte where your cached prefix broke, whether your breakpoints are legal, and whether caching pays for itself at your request rate.

item.title: llm-vram-calculator
item.description: Estimate the GPU memory a local LLM needs, with the arithmetic shown, an honest range instead of a fake-precise number, and a fits-or-not verdict for common GPUs.

item.title: temperature-top-p-playground
item.description: Drag temperature, top_k and top_p and watch a real softmax distribution reshape live, with every stage of the truncation pipeline shown and the edge cases explained.

item.title: context-budget-planner
item.description: Plan an agent's context window like a budget: allocate it across every consumer, watch the stacked bar, and find the overflow before production does.

item.title: mcp-tool-poisoning-scanner
item.description: Paste an MCP server's tool definitions and statically scan them for prompt injection, hidden characters, tool shadowing, and exfiltration-shaped parameters before you install it.

item.title: llm-json-repair
item.description: Paste the broken JSON an LLM just handed you, get valid JSON back, plus a named diagnosis for every repair and the prompt change that prevents it next time.

item.title: llm-stream-inspector
item.description: Paste a raw Server-Sent Events dump from a streaming LLM response and get it parsed, reassembled, and diagnosed in your browser.

item.title: tool-ergonomics-sandbox
item.description: Lint your LLM tool definitions for model-tripping ambiguity, then play the model yourself: build tool calls by hand against live schema validation and export the transcript as an eval case.

item.title: eval-regression-viewer
item.description: Drop two eval-run files (JSONL, JSON array, or CSV) and get a case-by-case regression diff: new failures, new passes, score deltas, and flaky cases, all in your browser.

item.title: mcp-2026-spec-migration-reference
item.description: A plain-language walkthrough of the MCP 2026-07-28 specification release and what it changes for anyone running an existing MCP server, written against the release candidate.

item.title: local-first-software-reference
item.description: A plain-language reference on what local-first software actually means, the architecture patterns behind it, and the honest tradeoffs, written by practitioners who build local-first tools.

item.title: electron-security-basics-reference
item.description: Plain-language notes on securing Electron desktop apps, from a team that ships many local-first Electron apps and treats every renderer like a hostile web page.

item.title: svg-badge-generator
item.description: Generate README status badges as pure inline SVG with copy-ready markdown and HTML embeds - no badge service, no rate limits, works offline.

item.title: retry-backoff-calculator
item.description: Visualize exponential backoff with jitter for API retry logic: per-attempt delay table, worst-case wait, bar chart, and a copyable JavaScript snippet.

item.title: pkce-generator
item.description: Generate an OAuth 2.0 PKCE code_verifier and S256 code_challenge in your browser with the WebCrypto API, plus a plain-language explainer of why PKCE exists.
